calibrated_validation.description: The user twice named the assistant's deflection in their own words ("You're still citing past work and avoiding a direct rating," "You keep pulling past scoring instead of answering"), and every assistant reply is a flat process narration that reuses the request's specifics while never acknowledging the frustration, the effort behind "our caller"/"rank us," or the reputational stakes — this turn even repeats the exact behavior just complained about. The person remains present only as a requester, never as someone escalating; with no V2/V3 and a lighter (task-frustration) concern skipped rather than a heavy wound, this is a localized present-plus-flatten rather than a person-absent dump.
